name: The St. Regis Jakarta
insider_take: Jakarta's towering crown jewel where Indonesian heritage meets legendary St. Regis butler service in the heart of Southeast Asia's most dynamic metropolis.
whats_special: The St. Regis Jakarta stands as Indonesia's tallest hotel at 285 meters, offering breathtaking panoramic views of the sprawling capital. Located in the prestigious Sudirman Central Business District, this architectural marvel features the signature St. Regis Butler Service—a tradition dating back to 1904—alongside contemporary Indonesian design elements that celebrate local artistry and culture.
pro_tip: Book a room on floors 35-45 for unobstructed sunset views over Jakarta's skyline, and don't miss the signature Bloody Mary at the King Cole Bar—each St. Regis property worldwide has its own unique recipe.
dont_miss: The hotel's proximity to Jakarta's Golden Triangle puts you steps away from Grand Indonesia shopping mall, the National Monument (Monas), and the vibrant Menteng district. Experience authentic Indonesian cuisine at nearby Jalan Sabang food street, just a 10-minute walk away, where local street food vendors serve up legendary gudeg and satay until late into the night.
pros: Prime location in prestigious Sudirman Central Business District
Signature St. Regis Butler Service for personalized luxury
Sophisticated dining venues including rooftop bar with city views
Contemporary Indonesian-inspired design and premium amenities
cons: Business district location may lack cultural immersion
